name_note: Most genomes GTDB places in s__Faecalimonas phoceensis carry the NCBI name [Clostridium] nexile, the name used in the literature cited here; others carry the name Coprococcus phoceensis.

sentences.text: A systematic review of the multiple sclerosis gut microbiome reported higher abundance of Clostridium nexile associated with worse outcomes, such as higher MRI lesion volumes.
In a pilot study of erectile dysfunction, Clostridium nexile was among species more abundant in the patient group than in the control group.
Comparing colorectal cancer patients with healthy controls, Clostridium nexile was among seven species found to be significantly differently distributed between the groups.
